challenges.name: scan-vec-push
challenges.title: Write vec_push and vec_free for the scan log
challenges.description: The nightly scanlog tool loads every scan of the night into a growable array: struct scan_vec { struct scan *data; size_t len; size_t cap; }, which starts empty. The Tết quick fix grew the block by one record per push and assigned the result of realloc straight to data. Write vec_push so that the first allocation holds 4 records and the capacity doubles whenever the array is full, using the runner's xrealloc. When xrealloc fails, vec_push must return false and leave data, len, cap and every stored record exactly as they were. Write vec_free so it releases the block with xfree and resets the vector to {nullptr, 0, 0}. The runner prints len and cap after each push, stops at the first failed push, prints the total quantity per SKU, and counts xrealloc calls and live blocks.
